item.title: Big new World of Warcraft Midnight class tuning patch is bad news for Warriors and Mages, but makes healers more deadly
item.description: The new World of Warcraft Midnight patch notes implement a wide range of class buffs and nerfs, as Blizzard targets outliers on both sides.

item.title: Overwatch's Valentines Day dating sim Loverwatch is back for a limited time, but Blizzard's missing a trick
item.description: With Overwatch Season 1 underway, Blizzard has brought back its Valentines Day Loverwatch dating sim minigame, but it needs some new faces.

item.title: Automation builder Satisfactory is now Steam Deck Verified, becoming one of the most dangerous additions to Valve's handheld ever
item.description: If you love to build and hate having too much free time, Satisfactory is Steam Deck Verified and will burn away the hours wherever you are.

item.title: The Star Citizen free fly is back, giving you a chance to try the colossal space game as it nears a billion dollars in funding
item.description: Star Citizen’s free fly event offers five ships for you to zoom around the massive space MMO in, as its spinoff Squadron 42 nears launch.

item.title: Why you need a VPN if you're using ChatGPT or other AI chatbots
item.description: The latest ChatGPT caricatures trend has me worried about AI’s access to our private data. It’s one of the many reasons to start using a VPN.

item.title: The next Where Winds Meet expansion opens the door to a whole new region, and the action game's most stylish weapon pairing yet
item.description: The Where Winds Meet Hexi expansion arrives at the start of March, kicking off a journey into a three-zone region with new combat styles.

item.title: As cheats improve, Arc Raiders dev Embark is fighting back in its squad FPS The Finals, and warns players to watch their software
item.description: Arc Raiders and The Finals dev Embark Studios is improving its machine-learning anti-cheat, and warns about keyboard and mouse software.

item.title: Inspired by Stellaris and Age of Wonders, magical new 4X game launches an early demo ahead of Steam Next Fest
item.description: The Atre Dominance Wars demo lets you trial the 4X game’s prologue, getting a taste of all four planes of magic and its core gameplay loop.

item.title: Rainbow Six Siege unveils its Year 11 roadmap, featuring Solid Snake, and an iconic face and map from R6 Vegas
item.description: Ubisoft details the Rainbow Six Siege Year 11 roadmap, including Solid Snake and the arrival of Bishop from R6 Vegas in the multiplayer FPS.

item.title: The Hundred Line has changed how I think about choice and consequences in games, and I can't put it back in the box
item.description: The Hundred Line Last Defence Academy sets an unreasonable bar for the way meaningful choice and divergent storylines are handled in games.
